steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Identify HMI type
steps.body: Is this an LCD-in-door model (display in door) or a console model (controls on top panel)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: TEST #2A LCD in door vs TEST #2B console models.

steps.title: LCD model — visual checks
steps.body: Remove top panel. Verify ACU connectors, HMI connectors, and door harness are fully seated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove top panel. Verify ACU connectors, HMI connectors, and door harness are fully seated.

steps.title: LCD — all connections seated
steps.body: Are ACU, HMI, and door harness connections fully inserted?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Are ACU, HMI, and door harness connections fully inserted?

branches.label: Connection issue found
branches.oemOutcome: Reconnect harnesses and repeat HMI test.

steps.title: LCD — TEST #1 voltages and LED OK
steps.body: After TEST #1 ACU Power Check: are HMI 5V/12V present and ACU LED healthy?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After TEST #1 ACU Power Check: are HMI 5V/12V present and ACU LED healthy?

branches.label: Supplies OK
branches.oemOutcome: Replace HMI and housing assembly; verify with HMI test.

branches.label: Supplies or LED failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ACU — supply voltages not present or microcontroller fault.

steps.title: Console symptom category
steps.body: Primary symptom: display/indicators completely off (no partial buttons)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Primary symptom: display/indicators completely off (no partial buttons)?

steps.title: Console — access and inspect
steps.body: Remove top panel and console assembly (do not strain wires). Verify ACU and HMI connectors fully seated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove top panel and console assembly (do not strain wires). Verify ACU and HMI connectors fully seated.

steps.title: Console dead — TEST #1 passed
steps.body: After TEST #1: HMI supplies present and ACU LED blinking slowly?
steps.sourceExcerpt: After TEST #1: HMI supplies present and ACU LED blinking slowly?

branches.label: TEST #1 failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ACU — LED off or supplies missing.

steps.title: Console — partial UI / beep
steps.body: Verify HMI seated in console. Check Use & Care for muted button sounds.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Some buttons do not light / no beep — replace HMI and housing if visual checks pass.

steps.title: Replace HMI assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace HMI and housing assembly; run HMI test to verify.

steps.title: Replace LCD HMI
steps.oemOutcome: Replace HMI and housing assembly; run HMI test.

steps.title: Replace console HMI
steps.oemOutcome: Replace HMI and housing assembly; run HMI test.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ACU when HMI supplies or microcontroller fault confirmed.
